scope: Second review of legacy cleanup and its upgrade/retention boundaries

findings.title: Pending input-only uploads become permanently failed during upgrade
findings.trigger: An older outbox job has recorded frames but no race_proof and its original ticket has no accepted server run.
findings.behavior: The submission lookup returns run:null, the job is marked bmt-trajectory-v1, and the new encoder rejects the missing proof. The flush stores INVALID_REPLAY/422, removes its pending marker, and retry_upload refuses it. No submission request is sent. The original replay bytes and key remain, but automatic/manual recovery cannot submit them.
findings.recommendation: Provide a bounded input-only outbox recovery/conversion path using the original pinned contract before marking the job as current. Preserve the original operation/body until acknowledgment. Add an unaccepted pre-update job test alongside accepted-upload recovery.

findings.title: Native archive destination guard follows unchecked hash-directory junctions
findings.trigger: A preexisting ArchiveRoot/<sha256> directory is a junction.
findings.behavior: Root validation checks ArchiveRoot ancestors only. GetFullPath and StartsWith do not resolve the destination hash-directory junction. The archive follows it and moves the source outside the configured archive root.
findings.recommendation: Validate every existing ancestor of the final source and destination, including generated hash subdirectories, immediately before creating/removing/moving entries. Add a junction regression test. The reproduction moved only a dummy file within this isolated workspace fixture.

findings.title: Migration row-preservation regression test still queries intentionally dropped tables
findings.behavior: After upgrading from 0058 to head, fingerprints() uses metadata reflected before upgrade and selects discovery_budget. Migration 0062 removed it, so the test raises OperationalError rather than checking preserved domain rows. This is a stale regression test, not evidence of player-data loss.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly allow retirement of only discovery_budget/discovery_snapshots, assert their absence, and keep exact row-preservation assertions for every surviving preexisting domain table.

findings.title: Active deployment guide recommends a rejected legacy transport profile
findings.behavior: The deployment guide recommends BMT_TRANSPORT_PROFILE=legacy and promises frame fallback for unadvertised servers. Settings now accepts only compact and raises ValueError for legacy, while the client requires trajectory capability. Following the guide prevents startup.
findings.recommendation: Update the active rollout guide to current transport requirements and the private pre-update submission-recovery handshake; move superseded instructions to explicitly dated history.

findings.title: Unused rendering/menu helpers remain in shipping scripts
findings.behavior: _sand_bend_sample, _save_settings and _creator_name have no shipping callers; references to the latter two outside declarations occur only in archived test copies. _rename_dialog_position is exercised only by test_object_browser, while the current dialog uses keyboard_dialog.gd. The cleanup left unused methods and a test that does not exercise the current dialog positioning implementation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused helpers and migrate the positioning assertion to the actual KeyboardDialog integration. Preserve excluded historical control fixtures.
